newsitem.title: HUNGARY: C.Euro CESI index to include Slovenian, Slovak shrs.
newsitem.headline: C.Euro CESI index to include Slovenian, Slovak shrs.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday announced the modification of the Central European Share Index (CESI) to include stocks from Ljubljana and Bratislava in addition to Budapest, Prague and Warsaw.

According to the modification, which came under a regular review of the CESI index, the basket will include 73 shares from October 31 against the current 50 stocks, the BSE said in a statement following the decision of its council.
"As of October 31 the index basket will contain 73 shares, chosen from the highest capitalised and most liquid stocks of five central European stock exchanges," the statement said.

The 73 shares include 24 Polish, 20 Czech, 11 Hungarian, 10 Slovenian and eight Slovak papers, it said, adding that these 73 shares accounted for 76 percent of the total share market capitalisation of these five bourses at the end of September.
